name: Sheaf
description: Two stems leaning into each other at a fixed angle, bound into sheaves across the field.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 28%; top: 4%; width: 13%; height: 92%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(-16deg); transform: rotate(-16deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 59%; top: 4%; width: 13%; height: 92%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(16deg); transform: rotate(16deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
